title: Onboarding Flow Development, Meeting Intelligence Solution, and Q3 Budget Review
agenda: New onboarding flow wireframe revisions and developer handoff
Meeting intelligence AI solution for automated minutes generation
discussion_points: Sarah's design team completed wireframes for the new onboarding flow and received feedback from the design review. Mobile layout requires revision before handoff to developers. Sarah estimated 3-4 days for revisions, targeting Thursday delivery.
Anas confirmed the backend team can work in parallel on API endpoints. They will reuse the existing database schema from the old flow and extend it. Backend development estimated at one week.

Omar presented a meeting intelligence agent solution to address the time spent on manual meeting minutes. The tool would automatically generate structured minutes from recordings or notes using company templates and push action items to the planner.

Omar identified dependencies for the proof of concept: Azure speech API access and SharePoint templates. Meeting Lead committed to provisioning Azure resources by tomorrow. Anas agreed to provide SharePoint templates library access today.
Q3 budget review scheduled for next Monday. All attendees must submit department estimates by Friday with no exceptions.
decisions: Approved Sarah's plan to revise wireframes with another round of design feedback before developer handoff by Thursday.
Approved parallel backend development by Anas's team starting immediately on API endpoints.
Prioritized Omar's meeting intelligence agent proof of concept with a two-week deadline.
Committed to provisioning Azure speech API resources and SharePoint template access to unblock Omar's development.
Established Friday deadline for all department Q3 budget estimates.
